blocks.en: Appendix III: Training Needs Example + References

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Single-Use Systems (一次性使用系統, SUS) 導入時的 Training Plan (培訓計畫) 設計邏輯與範例表格結構
blocks.en: Understand the design logic and example table structure of a Training Plan for introducing Single-Use Systems (SUS)

blocks.zh: 掌握培訓計畫中 跨部門人員配置、內/外部訓練師、時程規劃與簽核流程的要素
blocks.en: Master the elements of a training plan: cross-functional staffing, internal/external trainers, scheduling, and the approval process

blocks.zh: 全面檢視 TR66 所引用的 122 條參考文獻，了解 SUS 領域的法規、標準與技術文獻脈絡
blocks.en: Review all 122 references cited in TR66 to understand the regulatory, standards, and technical literature landscape of the SUS field

blocks.zh: 辨識各參考文獻的類別（ICH 指引、USP 通則、ISO 標準、ASTM 方法、PDA 技術報告、期刊論文等）及其在 SUS 實務中的應用場景
blocks.en: Identify the category of each reference (ICH guidelines, USP general chapters, ISO standards, ASTM methods, PDA technical reports, journal articles, etc.) and where it applies in SUS practice

blocks.zh: 10.0 Appendix III: Training Requirements Example 10.0 附錄 III：教育訓練需求範例
blocks.en: 10.0 Appendix III: Training Requirements Example

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: SUS Implementation Training Plan (SUS 導入培訓計畫)：這是一次性使用系統導入時不可或缺的人員準備文件。它不只是「排課表」，而是一份系統性的 能力建構藍圖 (Competency Building Blueprint)，確保所有接觸 SUS 的人員在操作前已具備足夠的知識與技能。
blocks.en: SUS Implementation Training Plan: This is an essential personnel-readiness document when introducing single-use systems. It is not just a class schedule but a systematic Competency Building Blueprint, ensuring that everyone who touches SUS has sufficient knowledge and skills before operating.

blocks.zh: INT vs. EXT (內部 vs. 外部培訓)：
blocks.en: INT vs. EXT (internal vs. external training):

blocks.zh: INT (Internal)：由公司內部具備資格的培訓師執行，通常用於倉儲接收、廢棄物處理等公司特定流程
blocks.en: INT (Internal): Delivered by qualified in-house trainers, typically for company-specific processes such as warehouse receipt and waste handling

blocks.zh: EXT (External)：由 SUS 供應商或外部專家執行，通常用於設備操作、校驗、完整性測試等需要原廠知識的技術模組
blocks.en: EXT (External): Delivered by the SUS supplier or external experts, typically for technical modules that require vendor knowledge, such as equipment operation, calibration, and integrity testing

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你的工廠要從傳統不鏽鋼設備轉換到一次性系統，就像一家餐廳從使用瓷碗盤改成使用免洗餐具。雖然看似「更簡單」，但每個環節的操作方式都不同：倉庫人員要學會如何正確儲存塑膠袋（溫濕度管控）、生產人員要學會如何安裝與拆卸、品管人員要學會新的完整性測試方法。如果不經過系統性培訓就直接上線，就像讓沒學過微波爐操作的廚師去使用微波爐一樣危險。
blocks.en: Imagine your plant switching from conventional stainless steel equipment to single-use systems. It is like a restaurant changing from ceramic dishes to disposable tableware. It looks "simpler", but every step is handled differently: warehouse staff must learn to store plastic bags correctly (temperature and humidity control), production staff must learn how to install and remove them, and QC staff must learn new integrity testing methods. Going live without systematic training is as dangerous as letting a cook who has never been trained on a microwave use one.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 培訓計畫的幾個關鍵設計原則：
blocks.en: Key design principles of the training plan:

blocks.zh: 跨部門覆蓋：從倉儲、生產支援、生產操作到品管，所有接觸 SUS 的人員都需要對應的培訓模組
blocks.en: Cross-functional coverage: From warehouse and production support to production operations and QC, everyone who touches SUS needs the corresponding training modules

blocks.zh: 分階段實施：Q1 先完成基礎操作（接收、安裝、基本使用），Q2/Q3 再進行進階項目（校驗、廢棄物處理）
blocks.en: Phased implementation: Complete the basic operations first in Q1 (receipt, installation, basic use), then the advanced items (calibration, waste handling) in Q2/Q3

blocks.zh: 五方簽核：Manufacturing、Quality、QP、HR、Finance 五個部門簽核，確保培訓計畫獲得跨職能認可
blocks.en: Five-party approval: Sign-off by Manufacturing, Quality, QP, HR, and Finance ensures the training plan has cross-functional endorsement

blocks.zh: Realization Date（實際完成日期）：對比 Provisional Date 可追蹤培訓進度，這在 GMP 稽核時是重要的合規證據
blocks.en: Realization Date: Comparing it with the Provisional Date lets you track training progress, which is important compliance evidence during GMP audits

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，SUS 培訓計畫的挑戰更大，因為：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment the SUS training plan is more challenging because:

blocks.zh: 不同客戶可能使用不同供應商的 SUS 組件，人員需要多品牌操作能力
blocks.en: Different clients may use SUS components from different suppliers, so personnel need multi-brand operating skills

blocks.zh: 人員流動率較高，需要建立可持續的培訓體系而非一次性活動
blocks.en: Staff turnover is relatively high, so a sustainable training system is needed rather than a one-off activity

blocks.zh: 客戶稽核時經常要求查看培訓記錄，因此文件管理必須嚴謹
blocks.en: Client audits often ask to see training records, so document management must be rigorous

blocks.zh: 建議建立「SUS 培訓矩陣資料庫」，將培訓模組標準化，新人到職時可快速配對所需的培訓課程。
blocks.en: It is advisable to build an "SUS training matrix database" that standardizes training modules, so that new hires can quickly be matched to the training courses they need.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼「Bioreactor Bags: Reception & Storage」使用內部培訓師（INT），而「Preparation & Integration」使用外部培訓師（EXT）？請從知識專業性的角度分析。
blocks.en: Why does "Bioreactor Bags: Reception & Storage" use internal trainers (INT), while "Preparation & Integration" uses external trainers (EXT)? Analyze from the perspective of technical expertise.

blocks.zh: Finance 部門為什麼也需要簽核培訓計畫？這與 SUS 的成本管理有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does the Finance department also need to approve the training plan? How does this relate to SUS cost management?

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的培訓經理，如何設計一個能同時服務多個客戶專案的 SUS 培訓架構？
blocks.en: If you were a CDMO training manager, how would you design an SUS training framework that serves multiple client projects at the same time?

blocks.zh: 11.0 References 11.0 參考文獻
blocks.en: 11.0 References

blocks.zh: 參考文獻架構 (Reference Framework)：TR66 的 122 條參考文獻構成了一次性使用系統的完整知識體系。理解這些文獻的分類與層級，就等於掌握了 SUS 領域的「知識地圖」。
blocks.en: Reference Framework: The 122 references in TR66 make up a complete body of knowledge for single-use systems. Understanding how they are categorized and layered gives you a "knowledge map" of the SUS field.

blocks.zh: 這些文獻可以分為以下幾個層級：
blocks.en: These references can be grouped into the following layers:

blocks.zh: 第一層 — 法規框架：ICH 指引（Q6A–Q11）、21 CFR、EMA 指引 → 定義「必須做什麼」
blocks.en: Layer 1 - Regulatory framework: ICH guidelines (Q6A-Q11), 21 CFR, EMA guidelines → define "what must be done"

blocks.zh: 第二層 — 標準與方法：USP 通則、ISO 標準、ASTM 方法 → 定義「如何測試與驗證」
blocks.en: Layer 2 - Standards and methods: USP general chapters, ISO standards, ASTM methods → define "how to test and verify"

blocks.zh: 第三層 — 行業指引：PDA TR、BPSA 建議、ISPE 指南 → 定義「最佳實務做法」
blocks.en: Layer 3 - Industry guidance: PDA TRs, BPSA recommendations, ISPE guides → define "best practices"

blocks.zh: 第四層 — 技術文獻：期刊論文、會議報告 → 提供「科學依據與案例」
blocks.en: Layer 4 - Technical literature: Journal articles, conference papers → provide "scientific basis and case studies"

blocks.zh: 想像你在蓋一棟建築物。ICH 指引就像建築法規（告訴你最低安全標準）；USP/ISO/ASTM 就像工程標準與材料規範（告訴你如何測試混凝土強度）；PDA Technical Reports 就像建築師手冊（告訴你最佳設計實務）；而期刊論文就像工程案例研究（告訴你別人蓋過的樓有什麼經驗教訓）。你不會只看其中一層就動工，而是需要全面理解後才能做出正確的設計決策。
blocks.en: Imagine constructing a building. ICH guidelines are like the building code (the minimum safety standards); USP/ISO/ASTM are like engineering standards and material specifications (how to test concrete strength); PDA Technical Reports are like the architect's handbook (best design practices); and journal articles are like engineering case studies (lessons learned from buildings others have already built). You would not start construction after reading only one layer; you need a full understanding to make sound design decisions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 各類別參考文獻的關鍵應用
blocks.en: Key Notes - Key applications of each reference category

blocks.zh: ICH Q8–Q11 系列：這是 SUS 導入的品質管理哲學基礎。Q8 的 Quality by Design (QbD) 概念指導你如何系統性地評估 SUS 對產品品質的影響；Q9 的 Quality Risk Management (QRM) 框架是 SUS 風險評估的方法論基礎；Q10 的 Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) 確保 SUS 變更管理有完整的品質系統支撐。
blocks.en: ICH Q8-Q11 series: This is the quality management philosophy underlying SUS implementation. The Quality by Design (QbD) concept in Q8 guides how to systematically assess the impact of SUS on product quality; the Quality Risk Management (QRM) framework in Q9 is the methodological basis for SUS risk assessment; the Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) in Q10 ensures that SUS change management is backed by a complete quality system.

blocks.zh: USP <87>/<88> 生物反應性測試：這是評估 SUS 材料生物相容性 (Biocompatibility) 的關鍵藥典方法。<87> 為體外試驗（細胞毒性），<88> 為體內試驗（動物植入）。在 SUS 材料選擇階段，這些測試是判斷材料是否適合與藥品接觸的第一道關卡。
blocks.en: USP <87>/<88> biological reactivity tests: These are key compendial methods for evaluating the biocompatibility of SUS materials. <87> is an in vitro test (cytotoxicity) and <88> is an in vivo test (animal implantation). At the SUS material selection stage, these tests are the first gate in deciding whether a material is suitable for contact with the drug product.

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables (E&L) 文獻群：TR66 引用了大量 E&L 相關文獻（Refs 27–31, 36, 38–46, 96–102），反映出 E&L 是 SUS 導入中最具技術挑戰性的領域。這些文獻涵蓋了從分析方法、安全閾值到風險評估策略的完整知識鏈。
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables (E&L) literature cluster: TR66 cites a large body of E&L literature (Refs 27-31, 36, 38-46, 96-102), reflecting that E&L is the most technically challenging area of SUS implementation. These references cover the complete chain from analytical methods and safety thresholds to risk assessment strategies.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 經濟與環境評估文獻
blocks.en: Key Notes - Economic and environmental assessment literature

blocks.zh: TR66 專門引用了多篇 SUS 經濟性分析文獻（Refs 53, 58–63），這在技術報告中相當少見，反映出 PDA 認知到 SUS 的導入決策不純粹是技術問題，而是需要 Total Cost of Ownership (TCO, 總擁有成本) 的全面評估。
blocks.en: TR66 specifically cites several SUS economic analysis references (Refs 53, 58-63), which is quite uncommon in a technical report. It reflects PDA's recognition that the decision to adopt SUS is not purely a technical question but requires a comprehensive assessment of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

blocks.zh: 同時，環境影響文獻（Refs 64–70, 82）也被大量引用，顯示 SUS 的「一次性」本質所帶來的廢棄物管理挑戰已成為行業關注焦點。CDMO 在向客戶提案時，需要能夠同時回答經濟效益與環境責任兩個面向的問題。
blocks.en: Environmental impact references (Refs 64-70, 82) are also heavily cited, showing that the waste management challenge arising from the "single-use" nature of SUS has become an industry focus. When presenting proposals to clients, a CDMO needs to be able to address both economic benefit and environmental responsibility.

blocks.zh: 如何在 CDMO 中活用這份參考文獻清單：
blocks.en: How to use this reference list in a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 供應商評估時：要求供應商提供符合 USP <87>/<88>、ISO 10993 的生物相容性測試報告，以及符合 BPSA 建議的 E&L 數據包
blocks.en: Supplier evaluation: Require suppliers to provide biocompatibility test reports that meet USP <87>/<88> and ISO 10993, and an E&L data package consistent with BPSA recommendations

blocks.zh: 變更管理時：使用 ICH Q9 的 QRM 框架進行風險評估，參考 PDA TR54 的實務案例
blocks.en: Change management: Use the ICH Q9 QRM framework for risk assessment, and refer to the practical cases in PDA TR54

blocks.zh: 客戶提案時：引用 Refs 59–63 的經濟分析方法進行 TCO 比較，引用 Refs 64、68、82 回應環境影響問題
blocks.en: Client proposals: Cite the economic analysis methods in Refs 59-63 for TCO comparison, and Refs 64, 68, and 82 to address environmental impact questions

blocks.zh: 法規申報時：確保 SUS 相關的 CMC 文件引用了正確的 ICH、USP、ISO 標準
blocks.en: Regulatory filings: Ensure that SUS-related CMC documentation cites the correct ICH, USP, and ISO standards

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 的參考文獻中，Extractables & Leachables 相關文獻佔比如此高（15.6%）？這反映了 SUS 領域的什麼技術挑戰？
blocks.en: Why do Extractables & Leachables references account for such a high share (15.6%) of TR66's references? What technical challenge in the SUS field does this reflect?

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 (QbD)、Q9 (QRM)、Q10 (PQS) 三者如何在 SUS 導入的不同階段發揮作用？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: How do ICH Q8 (QbD), Q9 (QRM), and Q10 (PQS) each come into play at different stages of SUS implementation? Please give examples.

blocks.zh: 如果你要建立一個 SUS 知識庫，你會如何將這 122 條文獻按優先順序分級？哪些是「必讀」、哪些是「參考」？
blocks.en: If you were building an SUS knowledge base, how would you prioritize these 122 references? Which are "must read" and which are "for reference"?

blocks.zh: 比較 USP <87>（體外）和 <88>（體內）生物反應性測試，在 SUS 材料評估中各自扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: Compare USP <87> (in vitro) and <88> (in vivo) biological reactivity tests: what role does each play in SUS material evaluation?

blocks.zh: 文獻統計分析 Reference Statistics
blocks.en: Reference Statistics

blocks.zh: 將 122 條參考文獻依類別統計：
blocks.en: The 122 references by category:

blocks.zh: 可以看出，SUS 導入實務與經濟評估（19.7%）以及品質/供應鏈/驗證（20.5%）佔比最高，反映 TR66 的核心關注在於「如何實際落地 SUS」而非純粹的技術規格討論。
blocks.en: SUS implementation practice and economic evaluation (19.7%) and quality/supply chain/validation (20.5%) account for the largest shares, which shows that TR66's core focus is "how to actually put SUS into practice" rather than a purely technical specification discussion.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 培訓計畫（Appendix III）：SUS 導入需要系統性的培訓計畫，涵蓋倉儲、生產支援、生產操作等跨部門人員。培訓模組應區分內部（INT）與外部（EXT）訓練師，並按時程分階段實施（基礎操作 → 進階校驗 → 專項技能）。五方簽核（Manufacturing、Quality、QP、HR、Finance）確保計畫獲得全面認可。
blocks.en: Training plan (Appendix III): SUS implementation needs a systematic training plan covering cross-functional personnel in warehouse, production support, and production operations. Training modules should distinguish internal (INT) from external (EXT) trainers and be phased over time (basic operations → advanced calibration → specialized skills). Five-party approval (Manufacturing, Quality, QP, HR, Finance) ensures the plan is fully endorsed.

blocks.zh: 參考文獻體系：TR66 的 122 條參考文獻構成四個層級的知識體系：法規框架（ICH）→ 標準與方法（USP/ISO/ASTM）→ 行業指引（PDA/BPSA/ISPE）→ 技術文獻（期刊/會議）。每個層級回答不同的問題：「必須做什麼」→「如何測試驗證」→「最佳實務」→「科學依據」。
blocks.en: Reference system: The 122 references in TR66 form a four-layer body of knowledge: regulatory framework (ICH) → standards and methods (USP/ISO/ASTM) → industry guidance (PDA/BPSA/ISPE) → technical literature (journals/conferences). Each layer answers a different question: "what must be done" → "how to test and verify" → "best practices" → "scientific basis".

blocks.zh: E&L 是核心挑戰：Extractables & Leachables 相關文獻在整體參考文獻中佔比高達 15.6%，反映出 SUS 材料與產品接觸時的化學相互作用是最具技術深度的議題，需要從分析方法、安全閾值到風險評估進行全面管理。
blocks.en: E&L is the core challenge: Extractables & Leachables references make up as much as 15.6% of all references, reflecting that the chemical interaction between SUS materials and the product is the most technically demanding topic, requiring comprehensive management from analytical methods and safety thresholds to risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 經濟與環境並重：TR66 大量引用 SUS 經濟性分析與環境影響評估文獻，強調 SUS 導入決策必須同時考量 Total Cost of Ownership 與廢棄物管理兩個維度，而非僅看初始採購成本。
blocks.en: Economics and environment both matter: TR66 heavily cites SUS economic analysis and environmental impact assessment literature, emphasizing that the decision to adopt SUS must consider both Total Cost of Ownership and waste management, not just the initial purchase cost.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務價值：這份參考文獻清單是 CDMO 建立 SUS 知識庫的最佳起點。善用分類索引，可快速找到供應商評估、變更管理、客戶提案、法規申報等不同場景所需的權威依據。
blocks.en: Practical value for CDMOs: This reference list is the best starting point for a CDMO to build an SUS knowledge base. Using the category index, you can quickly find the authoritative basis needed for different scenarios such as supplier evaluation, change management, client proposals, and regulatory filings.
